red_star_rosette_1.description: A six-pointed star rosette drawn in red ink, located in the left margin outside the main text column. These stars are the defining decorative feature of this folio and are consistent with the Astronomical/Stars section designation ($I=S). This star sits at the topmost position, flanking lines f116r.1–2. Star decorations do not encroach on the text column — they occupy negative space to the left of x~105.
